crossRefs.note: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and…
However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is…
Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the…
I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the…
and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say…
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…

translations.web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
translations.bsb: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
translations.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
translations.asv: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.
